description: This file defines the class BesselK, which provides functions to compute modified Bessel functions of the second kind, specifically for use within spreadsheet calculations. It includes methods for handling array inputs, validation, and computing specific Bessel function values.

classes.name: BesselK
classes.description: A class providing methods to calculate the modified Bessel function Kn(x) used in engineering and mathematical computations.

methods.name: BESSELK
methods.description: Public static method that evaluates the BesselK function for given input values, supporting array inputs, with validation and error handling.

methods.name: calculate
methods.description: Private static method to select the specific Bessel function implementation based on the order.

methods.name: callBesselI
